    input = sys.stdin.read

    N = int(data[0])
    index = 1
    G = [[] for _ in range(N)]
    for _ in range(N - 1):
        u = int(data[index]) - 1
        v = int(data[index + 1]) - 1
        index += 2
        G[u].append(v)
        G[v].append(u)
    
    A = list(map(int, data[index:index + N]))

    S = [defaultdict(int) for _ in range(N)]
    num = [defaultdict(int) for _ in range(N)]
    child = [1] * N
    hight = [0] * N
    
    stack = [(0, -1), (~0, -1)]
    ans = 0

        now, parent = stack.pop()
        if now < 0:
            now = ~now

                    stack.append((v, now))
                    stack.append((~v, now))
